content_fields.title: Enable signed image enforcement (Docker)
content_fields.description: Require that only signed images may be pulled or run.
content_fields.guidance: Content trust should be enforced at the daemon or admission layer so an unsigned image is refused, with signing keys held in a managed store and rotated.
content_fields.found: Images are referenced by floating tag with no signature requirement; enforcement is a daemon or platform setting.
content_fields.missing: Daemon content-trust configuration or an admission controller, plus a signing key hierarchy.
content_fields.conclusion: Signed-image enforcement is applied by the container platform, not by a file in this repository.
content_fields.action: The container platform team should enable and enforce content trust.
